item.title: Mullin To Be Sworn In
item.description: Markwayne Mullin will be sworn in at the White House today as the new Department of Homeland Security Secretary. The Senate voted 54-45 Monday to confirm the Oklahoma Republican Senator to replace Kristi Noem, who was fired by President Trump earlier this month and appointed as Special Envoy for The Shield of the Americas, a new anti-drug initiative in the Western Hemisphere. Democratic Senators John Fetterman of Pennsylvania and Martin Heinrich of New Mexico supported his confirmation.

item.title: Study Shows Depression Risk For Fathers Rises During First Year
item.description: A new study examines when fathers are most vulnerable to depression-like symptoms. Data collected by the JAMA Network Open shows the risk for new dads goes up by more than 30 percent toward the end of their child’s first year. Researchers tracked more than one-million fathers between 2003 and 2021. item.description: President Trump says he will soon sign an executive order to pay all Homeland Security employees as the partial government shutdown continues. item.title: Trump Says Operation Epic Fury Successful
item.description: President Trump is touting the success of Operation Epic Fury. While addressing the nation Wednesday night, Trump said Iran has been decimated militarily and economically. He said the U.S. will accomplish all its military objectives “shortly.” Trump said that once the conflict ends, the Strait of Hormuz will open naturally. Speaking to other nations dealing with fuel shortages, he advised them to either buy oil from the U.S. or go to the strait and take it themselves.

item.title: Russia Plans To Send Second Oil Tanker To Cuba
item.description: MOSCOW (AP) — Russia plans to send a second oil tanker to Cuba, the country’s energy minister said Thursday, citing the island’s ongoing energy blockade and reiterating Russia’s solidarity with the troubled Caribbean nation.
